errors.bulk_cancelled: The update was cancelled before it started. Nothing was changed.

errors.bulk_scope_mismatch: All documents was chosen, but the filter is not empty. Clear the filter, or choose to apply it to the matching documents only.
errors.compare_cap_exceeded: There are more differences than can be kept in memory, so the comparison stopped. Results kept for other pairs count against the same limit: discard some of them to free room. You can also narrow the comparison with a filter, or compare fewer fields.
errors.compare_duplicate_key: Two documents on one side have the same key, so they cannot be matched. Choose a key that is unique, or look up which values repeat.
errors.compare_key_invalid: A key field holds a value that cannot be used as a key (for example an array). Choose a different key.
errors.compare_key_missing: A document has no value for one of the key fields. Choose key fields that every document has.
errors.compare_key_not_indexed: No index covers this key, and the collection is too large to compare without one. Create an index on the key fields and try again.
errors.compare_key_order: The documents did not arrive in the expected key order, so the comparison was stopped to avoid wrong results. This can happen with an unusual collation; please report it if it persists.
errors.compare_setup_invalid: The key or field list is not valid. Each name must be non-empty, have no empty path segments, and be listed only once. Fields can be dotted paths such as address.city.
errors.copy_already_running: Another copy is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.copy_invalid_target_name: The target name is not one MongoDB accepts. Choose another name.
errors.copy_not_connected: A connection of this copy is not open. Reconnect and try again.
errors.copy_onto_itself: A collection cannot be copied onto itself. Choose another target.
errors.copy_server_owned: Databases and collections the server owns (admin, local, config and system collections) cannot be copied.
errors.database: The database reported a problem. Check your connection and try again.
errors.export_file_not_removed: The export failed and the incomplete file could not be removed. Delete it yourself before you use it.
errors.export_write_failed: The export could not be written. Check that the folder exists and that you are allowed to write to it, then try again.
errors.invalid_document: This document is not valid. Check its fields and try again.
errors.invalid_folder_name: The folder name is too long or contains characters that are not allowed.
errors.invalid_json: This is not valid JSON. Check the syntax and try again.
errors.invalid_name: The connection name is empty, too long or contains characters that are not allowed.
errors.invalid_namespace: That name is not allowed. Collection names cannot be empty, contain $ or start with system.; database names cannot contain spaces or / \ . " $ * < > : | ? and must be shorter than 64 bytes.
errors.invalid_uri: This connection string is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.invalid_uri_bad_host: A host in the connection string is not valid. Use a host name (letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores; a Unicode name must convert cleanly), a bracketed IPv6 address like [::1], or a socket path, and separate several hosts with commas.
errors.invalid_uri_bad_option: An option after the "?" is not valid. Write each option as name=value, separated by "&", and check its value.
errors.invalid_uri_bad_percent: The user name, password or another encoded part contains a "%" that is not a valid code. Write a literal "%" as %25.
errors.invalid_uri_bad_port: A port in the connection string is not valid. A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
errors.invalid_uri_missing_host: The connection string has no host. Put the server address after "mongodb://" or "mongodb+srv://".
errors.invalid_uri_missing_scheme: The connection string must start with "mongodb://" or "mongodb+srv://".
errors.invalid_uri_non_ascii_host: A host name contains characters other than letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores. Paste the connection string into the Fill from string box to convert it, or write the host in its punycode (xn--) form.
errors.invalid_uri_secret: A password or passphrase must not be part of the connection string. Remove it and enter it in the matching setting: the password field for the user's password, or the certificate or proxy settings for those secrets.
errors.invalid_uri_srv: A mongodb+srv:// connection string takes exactly one host name and no port. Use mongodb:// for several hosts or a port.
errors.invalid_uri_stray_at: A part of the connection string, most often the user name or password, contains a character that must be percent-encoded, such as @ (%40), # (%23), : (%3A) or / (%2F). Write it as its % code. A # fragment is not allowed.
errors.invalid_uri_user_needed: The connection string has a password but no user name. Remove the password or add a user name in front of it.
errors.invalid_uri_x509: X.509 authentication needs TLS turned on and a client certificate and key file. Turn on TLS and choose the file, or pick another authentication method.
errors.namespace_exists: A collection with that name already exists.
errors.not_found: The item could not be found. It may have been removed.
errors.read_only: This connection is read-only, so nothing was changed.
errors.reserved_database: This database belongs to the server and cannot be changed here.
errors.secret_store: Could not access the system keychain for saved credentials.
errors.snapshot_delete_failed: The undo copy could not be deleted. It is still on this computer; delete the files in the undo folder yourself if you do not want to keep them.
errors.snapshot_other_connection: This undo copy was saved on a different connection, so it cannot be restored here. Nothing was changed.
errors.snapshot_too_large: The documents to change are too large to save an undo copy of. Nothing was changed. You can run it without undo, or narrow the filter.
errors.snapshot_unreadable: The undo copy is missing or damaged, so it cannot be restored. Nothing was changed.
errors.snapshot_write_failed: The undo copy could not be saved, so nothing was changed. Check that there is disk space and that the app can write to its settings folder.
errors.ssh: The SSH tunnel could not be established. Check the SSH settings.

errors.superseded: The connection changed while this was running, so the result was discarded.
errors.tls_handshake: The server answered, but the secure (TLS) connection could not be set up. Check the TLS option, the CA file and client certificate, and whether the server expects TLS.
errors.tls_handshake_ssh: The secure (TLS) connection through the SSH tunnel could not be set up. Check the TLS option, the CA file and client certificate, and whether the server expects TLS.
errors.tls_through_tunnel: TLS certificate verification is not possible through an SSH tunnel. To connect you would have to enable "Allow invalid TLS certificates", which removes certificate protection on the connection between the SSH bastion and MongoDB (the SSH leg stays encrypted). Only do this on a network you trust.
errors.unauthorized: Your user is not allowed to do this on the server.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check that it is running, the address and network, and the TLS option.
errors.unreachable_ssh: Could not reach the server through the SSH tunnel. Check the tunnel host and credentials, that the server is running, and the TLS option.
errors.unreachable_write: Could not reach the server. The change may or may not have been applied; check the data before saving again.
errors.unreachable_write_ssh: Could not reach the server through the SSH tunnel. The change may or may not have been applied; check the data before saving again.
errors.unsupported: This action is not supported for the current connection.
errors.write_outcome_unknown: The connection was interrupted while saving. The change may or may not have been applied; check the data before saving again.

persist.skipped_repaired_backup_failed: {skipped} saved connection(s) were invalid or from a newer version and were not loaded, and {repaired} were adjusted to the current rules (a name or folder fixed, or a damaged production or read-only flag read as production or read-only). No backup copy could be made. Saving is turned off so the original file is not overwritten.
